history.follow_up: What is Francis Howard, 5th Baron Howard of Effingham's occupation?
history.answer: Francis Howard, 5th Baron Howard of Effingham was a member of the Howard family, descended from noted naval commander Lord High Admiral Howard, and a Crown Governor of Virginia (1683-1692).
history.docs:
[1] Francis Howard, 5th Baron Howard of Effingham: Francis Howard, 5th Baron Howard of Effingham Francis Howard, 5th Baron Howard of Effingham (c. 1643 – 30 March 1694 O.S./95 N.S.) was a member of the Howard family, descended from noted naval commander Lord High Admiral Howard, and a Crown Governor of Virginia (1683-1692). history.follow_up: Who is Christopher Butson?
history.answer: Christopher Butson was a Church of Ireland bishop in the first half of the 19th century. He was born in England in 1747, educated at Winchester and New College, Oxford, and served as Dean of Waterford, Chancellor of Ferns and Leighlin, and Bishop of Clonfert and Kilmacduagh. He died in office on 22 March 1836.
